validated_results.title: Population attributable risk of renal cell cancer in Minnesota.
validated_results.reason: Population-based case-control study of histologically confirmed incident renal cell cancer that evaluated elevated protein intake as a candidate dietary risk factor.

sample_size.excerpt: It included 690 histologically confirmed incident cases identified through the state cancer surveillance system, and 707 age and sex frequency-matched controls. In this paper, the authors present estimates of the proportion of renal cell cancer cases attributable (or population attributable risk (PAR)) to 1) well-established risk factors, namely smoking, excess weight, and hypertension, and 2) more speculative risk factors, namely elevated protein intake, history of renal disease (i.e., stone, injury, or infection) and high parity among women.
